description: handleAuthRequest at shell/index.ts:131-165 is a test-only harness, not a real implementation. It hardcodes parameters for the /v1/auth/discord/start endpoint: clientId='client-id', redirectUri='https://api.example.com/callback', state='state-123', cookie value='session-value' (lines 154-159). These are literals, not derived from actual request processing. The function does not accept request parameters (query strings, cookies) needed for real endpoint behavior. Integration tests (PROP-AUTH-013, 014, 015, 016, 017, 019) exercise this function, but they are testing a hardcoded scaffold, not the actual auth flow composition. The contract (sprint-1.md:115) acknowledges this as a 'minimal shell handler' but presents it as satisfying Tier 2 integration requirements.
